title: Listing Highlight: 33' Riva Aquariva Super 2020 | MIA MIA
description: Discover the 2020 Riva Aquariva Super in Miami—a masterpiece of Italian craftsmanship offering luxury, performance, and charter-ready sophistication.
html:
A Sophisticated 60+ Foot Yacht Combining Timeless Design With Contemporary Comfort

The 2020 Riva Aquariva Super represents a pinnacle of Italian yacht design, blending the heritage of one of the world’s most storied builders with contemporary engineering and comfort. This vessel, available through FYI Yachts, embodies the essence of Mediterranean elegance while delivering the performance and amenities expected by discerning owners and charter guests alike.

Built in 2020 and measuring over 60 feet, the Aquariva Super stands as a testament to Riva’s commitment to craftsmanship, featuring a sleek profile that turns heads in any anchorage. The yacht’s exterior showcases the signature Riva aesthetic—clean lines, refined proportions, and meticulous attention to detail that have made the brand synonymous with luxury boating for generations. The hull design optimizes both speed and stability, ensuring a smooth ride across varied sea conditions while maintaining the graceful appearance that defines the Aquariva line.

Interior spaces flow seamlessly, with a well-appointed salon that welcomes guests into an atmosphere of understated luxury. Natural light floods the cabin through strategically placed windows and skylights, creating an airy ambiance that belies the vessel’s substantial size. The galley is fully equipped for preparing gourmet meals, while the dining and lounge areas provide flexible configurations for entertaining or relaxing. Multiple staterooms offer comfortable accommodations, each designed with the same attention to detail evident throughout the yacht.

The master suite is particularly noteworthy, featuring an ensuite head with premium fixtures and ample storage. Guest cabins maintain the same standard of comfort and finish, ensuring that everyone aboard enjoys a refined experience. The crew quarters are thoughtfully positioned, allowing service staff to move efficiently without intruding on guest spaces. Modern climate control, entertainment systems, and navigation technology integrate seamlessly into the design, enhancing both comfort and safety.

Performance specifications reflect Riva’s engineering excellence. Twin diesel engines deliver reliable power and efficiency, while the yacht’s hull design minimizes fuel consumption without sacrificing speed. Cruising range and fuel capacity have been optimized for extended voyages, making this vessel suitable for both weekend getaways and longer expeditions. The yacht’s systems are robust and well-maintained, with redundancy built into critical equipment for added peace of mind.

As a charter-ready vessel, the 2020 Riva Aquariva Super is positioned to generate strong revenue while maintaining the owner’s personal use schedule. The layout naturally accommodates professional crew, and the yacht’s reputation and condition make it an attractive offering in the charter market. FYI Yachts specializes in vessels like this—newer than 2000, 60 feet and above, and ideal for owners seeking both lifestyle enjoyment and financial returns. Contact FYI Yachts today to schedule a private walkthrough and experience the sophistication of the Aquariva Super firsthand.
